docs.summary: Builds the embedded default models (Cube, Sphere, ...) as prefabs. A model file is imported into a [`PrefabAsset`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.PrefabAsset) like any other, so these are too; this exists only because the defaults come from embedded resources rather than the asset database.
Loads a default embedded model (Cube, Sphere, etc.) as a prefab.
